source: Allard & Atalla 2e Table 12.1, PDF page 297 (printed p. 292)
about: Table 12.1, "Parameters of the plate-foam system": the foam bonded to the 1 mm aluminium panel of the finite-size transmission loss example of Figures 12.3 and 12.4. Columns as printed: thickness h (mm), phi, sigma (N s/m4), alpha_inf, Lambda (um), Lambda' (um), rho_1 (kg/m3), E (Pa), nu and eta_s. The foam's thickness cell prints the word "variable": the figures this table serves put it at 5.08 cm (printed p. 291) and the same foam comes back at two, three and four and a half inches later in the chapter (printed pp. 294-295), so no one number is the row's. The word is kept. It is the foam of Table 11.5, here with its elastic constants. The panel row, 2742 kg/m3, E 6.9e10, nu 0.3, eta 0.007, is not a porous material and is not here.
